_doc: Currency conversion test cases (docs/API.md 'Currency conversion'; app/lib/domain/fx.dart). rate = major units of the target currency per 1 major unit of the source currency (1 JPY = 0.00616 EUR → 0.00616). fn: amount = convertAmount(amount, fromDecimals, toDecimals, rate) → expected (an integer), expense = convertExpense(amount, parts, fromDecimals, toDecimals, rate) → expected {amount, parts}. Instead of expected there may be error (an FxException code: BAD_RATE | NEGATIVE_AMOUNT | SUM_MISMATCH). Exact value = amount × R × 10^(toDecimals − fromDecimals), where R is the decimal number rate.toString() prints (Dart's shortest round-trip form; in Kotlin the same digits as JDK 19+ Double.toString). No double multiplication. Rounding goes to the nearest integer, exactly .5 away from zero. expense: total = convertAmount(amount), each part is the floor of its exact value, and the leftover goes +1 each to the parts with the largest dropped fraction first (on a tie memberId ascending; a 0 part gets none). Check order: BAD_RATE → NEGATIVE_AMOUNT → SUM_MISMATCH. Both Dart (test/domain/fx_test.dart) and Kotlin (FxCasesTest, the money/Fx.kt port) read this file.
